answer: Each new identity must claim one real premises and pass an independent inspection for weight. An inspector arrives unannounced on a comet schedule, verifies equipment in use, and files a report; weight starts after a pass, renewed yearly. Each fake costs 450 units in fees, 2,400 units of annual rent and 30 days, so 100 fakes cost 285,000 units. A shell kept only as a relic, empty and workless, fails; an ivory-tower front with no staff fails too. Forged reports fail because only the inspector's key signs one and all reports are public; sampling neighbouring premises exposes fake clusters.
